    Paths in the universal cover #

    A path of the universal cover projects to a path of P with the same length and value (Cover.projPath, Cover.pathVal_projPath); a path of P lifts to a path of the cover from any point over its start (Cover.exists_liftPath), and the lift ends at the point given by the homotopy class of the path.
